question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The weather was __absolutley__ perfect for the outdoor event.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "Absolutley" is an incorrect spelling of **"absolutely"**. (त्रुटिपूर्ण वर्तनी)
 
• The word **"absolutely"** means completely or totally; it indicates something done without any exceptions. (पूरी तरह से)
 
 
• **Example: **She was absolutely certain that she had locked the door before leaving.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**
